div.div: رَبَلَةٌ (AZ, T, S, M, K) and ↓ رَبْلَةٌ , (S, M, K,) the former said by As to be the more chaste, (S,) The inner part of the thigh; (AZ, T, S, M, K;) i. e., of each thigh, of a man: (AZ, T:) or any large portion of flesh: (M, K:) or the parts (M, K) of the inner side of the thigh [or of each thigh] (M) that surround the udder (M, K) and the vulva: (K:) pl. رَبَلَاتٌ; (AZ, T, S, M, K;) which Th explains as meaning the roots of the thighs. (M, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
